title: Metabolite Identification in Candida albicans
protocol: Suspend frozen yeast cell pellets from 500-ml cultures in 5 ml lysis solution.
Add equal amount of glass beads to the pellet to facilitate cell lysis.
Vortex for 1 min followed by resting on ice for 1 min, repeat for 15 cycles.
Centrifuge at 13,400 × g for 30 min.
Subject the supernatants to tandem affinity purification (TAP).
Incubate cell lysates with 50 ul of anti-FLAG M2 agarose for 2 h at 4°C.
Perform a second round of purification with Ni-nitrilotriacetic acid (NTA) agarose for 1 h at 4°C.
Wash the beads once in 300 mM ammonium acetate for 5 min.
Wash the beads again in 150 mM ammonium acetate for 5 min.
Add 60 ul of pure methanol to the beads twice, incubating at room temperature for 10 min.
Transfer the methanol extract to a Waters Max Recovery glass vial.
Analyse by mass spectrometry.
Boil the beads in 50 μl of 1× SDS sample buffer for 5 min.
Analyse 15 μl of the supernatant on a 12% SDS-PAGE gel.
Stain the gel using a silver staining reagent (Bio-Rad).
Load 10 μl of metabolite extract onto a C18 column.
Use a binary solvent gradient from 5% to 95% methanol in water for 12 min, followed by 95% methanol for another 5 min.
Maintain the collection mass range between 100 and 1,200 m/z in profile scan mode.
Keep the probe temperature at 500°C and source temperature at 130°C.
Process the data through MarkerLynx software, version 4.1 (Waters Co., Milford, MA).
